note: Every unobserved number used by the model is declared here with its basis. No assumption is presented as a fact, a quotation or a validated market input.

decisionRules.ruleOrderNote: A lower rule never overrides a higher one. A material unknown unit-variable cost forces COST_MODEL_INCOMPLETE; a fixed one-off unknown (certification, tooling, insurance) is excluded from unit contribution and listed separately, so it does not by itself block a conditional unit case.
decisionRules.scoreScale: 0 = no evidence / hard block, 5 = fully evidenced and ready

assumptions.statement: Spanish standard VAT rate of 21% is applied to consumer-facing hardware and digital subscriptions to convert a VAT-inclusive price hypothesis into ex-VAT net revenue.
assumptions.notes: Confirmed by the legal-tax research. Reduced rates are not assumed to apply to these digital services.

assumptions.statement: Conversion rule: net revenue = gross hypothesis / (1 + VAT/100); a VAT-excluded B2B price is used as net revenue directly.
assumptions.notes: The conversion is disclosed on every revenue line.

assumptions.statement: No price is approved. Every selling price used is an unapproved hypothesis from MC-05/MC-08 or an explicit symbolic entry figure.
assumptions.notes: PRICE_APPROVED = NONE.

assumptions.statement: The base hardware configuration is a self-install hardware-only sale: MC-11 COST-12 installation labour is excluded from the unit variable cost and treated as a separately quoted service.
assumptions.notes: The installer-included configuration is modelled separately and never mixed with the self-install figure.

assumptions.statement: Tooling/NRE amortisation (COST-16) and the certification programme (COST-17) are fixed one-off costs, excluded from unit contribution and listed separately. Certification is reclassified from a per-unit amortisation to a fixed programme cost for contribution analysis.
assumptions.notes: MC-11 includes COST-16 inside knownSubtotalEur; MC-12 removes it from variable cost and never adds toolingAmortizationEur again. The certification amount remains UNKNOWN and is never treated as zero.

assumptions.statement: WATCH monitoring subscription hypothesis of EUR 9.90/month, VAT-inclusive, from the MC-08 register.
assumptions.notes: Subscription contents are OPEN; no monitoring service exists.

assumptions.statement: FLEET per-vessel SaaS hypotheses of EUR 49 (START) and EUR 79 (BUSINESS) per vessel-month, VAT-excluded B2B; hardware is never included by default.
assumptions.notes: PH-06 package price is NOT_ESTABLISHED; only the per-vessel SaaS hypothesis exists.

assumptions.statement: Distribution channels: direct card processing at the published EEA rate; app-store commission 30% (15% small-business condition); installer trade margin 15%; distributor/retail margin 35%. The last three are explicit hypotheses, not negotiated terms.
assumptions.notes: Only the card-processing rate is a published tariff.

assumptions.statement: Consumer support allowance of EUR 6 per active account-year and EUR 4 per active hardware device-year; FLEET support EUR 24 per vessel-year. No support model, ticket rate or response-time commitment exists.
assumptions.notes: These are allowances, not observed costs.

assumptions.statement: Returns and withdrawal exposure of 3% of net revenue, reflecting the 14-day distance-selling withdrawal right at an assumed return rate.
assumptions.notes: No return-rate data exists. Derived allowance lines are computed from the exact net revenue and then rounded to 2 decimals; a 0.01 EUR difference against re-deriving from the already-rounded net figure is a rounding artefact, not an arithmetic error (e.g. WATCH returns 2.94 vs 2.95).

assumptions.statement: Cloud cost drivers: EUR 0.12 per account-month, EUR 0.15 per device-month, EUR 0.50 per FLEET vessel-month; 12-month telemetry retention. Derived from published on-demand tariffs under a BASE usage profile.
assumptions.notes: BASE vendor subtotal of EUR 0.15484/device-month at 1,000 devices from published AWS IoT Core, Lambda, R2 and Workers tariffs (recurring-cost-inputs.json RC-006..RC-017). No cloud agreement exists; this is a modelled floor.

assumptions.statement: Cellular IoT allowance of EUR 0.05 per device-month for 10 MB/month at the published Spain/EU pay-as-you-go rate, with plan-level alternatives of EUR 0.10-0.375 per device-month. No operator or MVNO contract exists and terrestrial coverage offshore is not assumed.
assumptions.notes: 10 MB/month at the published iot.cards Spain/EU pay-as-you-go rate of EUR 0.005/MB (recurring-cost-inputs.json RC-002), with no monthly minimum. Alternative plans are EUR 0.10-0.375/device-month (1NCE, Soracom). A published tariff is not a negotiated service and offshore coverage is not assumed.

assumptions.statement: Notification allowance of EUR 0.070714 per device-month for the BASE alert mix (6 alerts, 15% SMS, push/email, retries and history). Modelled delivery cost never becomes a guaranteed alert-delivery claim.
assumptions.notes: BASE alert mix: 6 alerts/device-month, 15% by SMS at the published Twilio Spain rate plus SES email (recurring-cost-inputs.json RC-022). No notification contract exists and no guaranteed-delivery claim is made.

assumptions.statement: The SENSE entry hypothesis of EUR 99 is the MC-08 symbolic entry figure, not an edition price. It is used only to expose the module cost structure.
assumptions.notes: No SENSE edition price exists in the product data.

assumptions.statement: The EUR/USD conversion of 0.925925926 is inherited from the MC-11 engineering assumption ASM-001; the ECB reference rate could not be retrieved when MC-11 was prepared.
assumptions.notes: Must be replaced by an observed ECB rate before any procurement decision.

assumptions.statement: Customer acquisition cost, churn, renewal rate and willingness to pay are UNKNOWN. No demand figure is used in any calculation.
assumptions.notes: CUSTOMER_EVIDENCE = NONE; CUSTOMER_WTP_VALIDATED = false.

assumptions.statement: Evidence older than 180 days relative to the analysis date is not silently reused.
assumptions.notes: All MC-12 observations are dated 2026-11-02.

assumptions.statement: Contribution means net revenue ex-VAT minus known variable cost, before fixed operating costs. It is not gross margin, EBITDA or net profit.
assumptions.notes: Fixed costs excluded: tooling/NRE, engineering NRE, certification programme, insurance, annual security maintenance.

assumptions.statement: Decision-matrix weights are pre-registered: cost evidence 25, recurring certainty 15, licensing readiness 20, technical readiness 10, customer evidence 15, regulatory readiness 10, contribution confidence 5.
assumptions.notes: Fixed before scoring so results cannot choose their own weights.

assumptions.statement: The recurring cost of inactive or suspended devices is modelled as zero telemetry but retained account/identity and storage cost; no provider has been asked whether a suspended SIM is free.
assumptions.notes: Suspension terms are unknown.

assumptions.statement: An ECB euro reference rate of USD 1.1216 per EUR (EUR 0.8916 per USD) was observed on 2026-11-02 by the connectivity research and is recorded in the provider evidence and recurring-cost-inputs FX basis.
assumptions.notes: This closes the MC-11 FX observation gap for new MC-12 conversions only. The inherited MC-11 BOM lines keep their recorded conversion (0.925925926, ASM-001) and are NOT re-converted, to avoid mixing two bases in one subtotal; MC-13 should refresh the BOM conversion.

assumptions.statement: Recurring cost drivers are taken from recurring-cost-inputs.json: cellular EUR 0.05/device-month (BASE PAYG), cloud EUR 0.155/device-month (BASE vendor subtotal), notifications EUR 0.070714/device-month, cloud EUR 0.02/account-month and EUR 0.10/vessel-month. Each is a published tariff or a labelled assumption, never a contract.
assumptions.notes: No connectivity, cloud, notification, payment or distribution contract exists.
